storage_classes.name: IDrive e2 Pay-as-you-go

price.note: Pricing page: 'Straight-forward and tierless pricing $0.006/GB per month ($6/TB per month)'. One price without regional variation; the page does not mention regions, so it is applied to all listed regions. Minimum charge 1 TB per month (see notes).

put_per_1000.note: Pricing page: 'IDrive e2 does not impose any additional charges for your API calls'; FAQ: no additional charges for ingress, egress, data deletion and API requests.

get_per_1000.note: Pricing page: 'IDrive e2 does not impose any additional charges for your API calls'; FAQ: no additional charges for ingress, egress, data deletion and API requests.

list_per_1000.note: Pricing page: 'IDrive e2 does not impose any additional charges for your API calls'; FAQ: no additional charges for ingress, egress, data deletion and API requests.

price_per_gb.note: No retrieval fee line on the pricing page; absence of a line item, not an explicit statement.

typical_delay.note: Not stated in the sources checked.

minimum_storage_duration_days.note: Pricing FAQ: 'IDrive e2 does not impose a minimum storage duration on uploaded objects nor charge users for deleting the objects'.

minimum_billable_object_size_kb.note: Not stated on the pricing page or FAQ checked.

notes: Minimum storage fee: pay-as-you-go accounts are charged for at least 1 TB ($6) per month even when storing less (pricing page FAQ).
Yearly plans (from $59.50/year for 1 TB, 50% off the first year as a limited-time offer), Veeam/MSP/reseller pricing ($5/TB/month) and multi-year plans are not modelled.
Yearly-plan overuse beyond the plan size: $0.006/GB/month (pricing page footnote).

free_allowance_gb_per_month.note: Not a fixed amount: free egress is up to 3x the active storage volume per month, see free_allowance_scope.

egress.free_allowance_scope: Free egress policy: monthly downloads up to 3x the active storage volume are free (pricing page).

price.note: Pricing page footnote: 'Free Egress Policy: Charges apply at $0.01/GB/month beyond free limits' (interpreted as per GB transferred above 3x active storage).

notes: The pricing page also has a blurb 'Free ingress and egress' and an FAQ saying there are no additional charges for egress; the footnote with the $0.01/GB overage is used here.

egress_fair_use.value: Download less than or equal to 3X your active storage volume for free; beyond that, charges apply at $0.01/GB.

free_tier.value: Pay-as-you-go: 'Try with 10 GB Free' (duration and conditions not stated on the pricing page); Veeam/MSP/reseller plan: 'Try with 1TB Free'.

object_lock.note: Product page feature list: 'Object lock: Object locking brings immutability to the objects'; also bucket versioning.

No general statement found; IDrive's own ChronoSync guide (https://www.idrive.com/s3-storage-e2/chronosync-guide) says to select 'Use path-style URLs'. Virtual-hosted support was not verified.

notes: Regions must be enabled per account in the dashboard before creating buckets there (developer guide https://www.idrive.com/s3-storage-e2/developer-guide). The developer guide says 15 regions; the endpoint URLs page lists 19.
Tax: the pricing page does not state whether prices include tax; no official tax statement could be read today (help center unreachable), so prices_include_tax is null.
The optional SSD storage tier appears only in commented-out markup on the pricing page and is not modelled.

Path-style addressing: No general statement found; IDrive's own ChronoSync guide (https://www.idrive.com/s3-storage-e2/chronosync-guide) says to select 'Use path-style URLs'. Virtual-hosted support was not verified.
